Order.title: PrintOrder
Order.description: Student assignment print order with customer details, single/multi-file PDF/DOC/DOCX metadata, selected services, configurable pricing breakdown, payment status, envelope personalization, WhatsApp bot session ref, and delivery instructions.

customer.description: Student identification and academic metadata (supports optional alternative phone number).

document.description: Primary uploaded document summary (filename, total pages, size, Firebase Storage path, and secure download reference).

documents.description: Multi-file list of uploaded PDF, DOC, and DOCX files (up to 10 files).

selectedServices.description: List of selected printing and finishing service IDs.

printing.description: Printing type, page distribution, sides, copies, paper size, stapling/binding preference, and brown envelope quantity.

pricing.description: Calculated itemized costs for printing, packaging, delivery fee, additional services, approved extra charges, total, and currency.

payment.description: Selected payment method, optional transaction reference, and verification status.

envelopeLabel.description: Generated personalized brown envelope label fields and Storage path.

whatsappNotification.description: Status of automated WhatsApp Cloud API administrator notification.

emailNotification.description: Status of automated email dispatch with attachments and student info to administrator inbox.

whatsappSession.description: WhatsApp bot conversational session state and conversation reference.

quotation.description: Quotation generated or sent by the WhatsApp bot or administrator.

OrderAuditEntry.title: OrderAuditEntry
OrderAuditEntry.description: Immutable audit trail record for order status, payment verification, quotations, and notification retries.

StudioSettings.title: StudioSettings
StudioSettings.description: Public storefront configuration for currency and official Orange Money / Africell Money payment instructions.

PricingConfig.title: PricingConfig
PricingConfig.description: Administrator-defined dynamic pricing rates for B&W, colour, single/double sided, brown envelopes, binding, delivery fee, and additional services.

ServicesCatalog.title: ServicesCatalog
ServicesCatalog.description: Administrator-configurable catalog of printing, packaging, scanning, photocopying, and delivery services.

AdminPrivateSettings.title: AdminPrivateSettings
AdminPrivateSettings.description: Restricted administrator settings including recipient WhatsApp numbers, notification email, and WhatsApp template configuration.

adminWhatsappNumbers.description: List of administrator WhatsApp phone numbers (max 5).

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized print shop administrator document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer print orders; creatable by validated submission, readable/updatable only by authorized admins.

/orders/{orderId}/audit/{auditId}.description: Immutable audit trail entries for each order.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Public storefront settings: studio (StudioSettings), pricing (PricingConfig), services (ServicesCatalog).

/adminSettings/{settingId}.description: Admin-only WhatsApp notification phone numbers and template configuration.
